result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Delete an image

USAGE:
    pixault images delete [id] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [id]    Image ID to delete (omit when selecting by --ids/--files or a       
            filter)                                                             

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help        Prints help information                                   
    -p, --project     Project ID (overrides config default)                     
        --ids         Comma-separated image IDs to delete                       
        --files       Comma-separated original filenames to delete              
        --all         Delete ALL images in the project (across every folder;    
                      ignores other selectors)                                  
    -s, --search      Delete images matching this text search (name/filename/id)
    -c, --category    Delete images in this category                            
    -k, --keyword     Delete images with this keyword                           
        --folder      Delete every image in this folder                         
        --video       Limit to videos (true) or images (false)                  
        --max         Safety cap: refuse if more than this many images match    
                      (default 500)                                             
        --dry-run     Preview what would be deleted without deleting anything   
    -y, --yes         Skip the confirmation prompt

DESCRIPTION:
Generate SEO-optimized HTML embed tag

USAGE:
    pixault images embed <id> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <id>    Image ID

OPTIONS:
                       DEFAULT                                                  
    -h, --help                    Prints help information                       
    -p, --project                 Project ID (overrides config default)         
    -w, --widths                  Comma-separated breakpoint widths (default:   
                                  400,800,1200)                                 
        --sizes                   CSS sizes attribute (default: 100vw)          
        --alt                     Alt text for the image                        
    -t, --transform               Named transform to apply                      
    -q, --quality                 Quality (1-100)                               
        --loading                 Loading behavior: lazy or eager (default:     
                                  lazy)                                         
        --class                   CSS class(es) for the img element             
        --picture      True       Use <picture> element with AVIF/WebP sources  
                                  (default: true)
